text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho enjoyed spending the
weekends at her grandma's home,
a
remote place surrounded by all kinds of
wild flora.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There, she studied magic under her
grandmother, who lived a free
lifestyle
befitting that of a great witch.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Well then, are you ready, Sweepy? Give it
a try yourself—just like I
taught you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Grandma! Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Gera, gera—uninium! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Nicely done. Now, you smell that? That
sweet, flowery smell—it never
fails to bring
a smile to this old lady's face.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff... Hey, you're right! Wowie, wow, I really did it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that was a perfect display of herbal
geranium magic. What's
more, this strong
scent also drives away nasty pests.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
And that's not all—now we can make
delicious herbal tea and jam,
too! Come
here Sweepy, help me carry these.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Okay! Hehe, "gera, gera, uninium! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Wowie! Magic is so super fun! I wanna do
more... There's gotta be
sooo many more
spells I can learn!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Grandma! You see, I wanna learn a
lot, lot more magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So I was wondering, what's the bestest,
most amazingest spell you've
ever cast?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: My best spell, you say? Let me think...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
...It would have to be racing magic, no
doubt about it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
The racing scene is special,
you see. You'll find all kinds of
spells—some that'll make
you jump for joy, others that'll make your
 heart flutter... or even feel sad.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
But you know, there's a one-of-a-kind
magic that can only be used there. Back
when I used to race in my younger days, I
found and
learned that magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
My little Sweepy. I hope that one day, you
too will learn to wield that
very same
magic...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
And when you do, I believe you'll finally
find the "fun" you've been looking
for—and it'll be better than you could
ever
imagine.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Then what are we waiting for?! I wanna
race too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And then, just like Grandma, I'll show
everyone the most amazingest
magic in the
whole world!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! How about that—I'm looking
forward to seeing just what
kind of magic
you'll use.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Magic is fun. With it, everything that bores me gets blown away.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to learn more magic like that,
so I
came to Tracen Academy
to look for this
racing magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But no matter how much I run, I can't find
it anywhere! And the teachers and
instructors are always getting on my case
and telling me
what to do!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So I've had it! This isn't fun at all!
It's
boring! Everything is sooo
boring now!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. Maybe I should just... quit racing.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I blurt that out before I can stop myself.
After all, the image of her comeback in
that scrimmage is still freshly seared
into
my mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And besides, after hearing that story of
hers, I feel like I understand
what her
grandmother was thinking back then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She exceeded in so many different areas,
but none of them were fun for her.
Because all those activities weren't what
she really wanted to
do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What's important is whether or not she
wants to do something. That's why her
grandmother showed her magic. She gave
Sweep the
motivation she needed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho made the decision by herself
to enter the racing scene.
She did it
because she wanted to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The only person who can brighten up her
life, who can make it exciting—is herself.
But if she's having trouble taking the
next step
alone, then...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Of course not, dummy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I mean,
it's the best magic there is! And I,
Sweepy, will one day
become a great
witch fit to wield that power!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...And y'know, I promised her. I promised
Grandma that I would learn
racing magic!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I reassure her with complete and utter
confidence. Because there's no
doubt in
my mind that—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I say this sincerely because I saw it
with my own two eyes. Because I
want the magical
girl in front of me to never stop
believing in magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because I hope that this seed of potential
can sprout amid adversity
into a beautiful
blossom.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The world of racing? Can I find the magic
I'm looking for there?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Then from today on, you're my familiar.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You don't even know what a familiar is?
What a dummy. A familiar is always by
their magical girl's side and helps them
with aaall kinds of
things!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Until I learn racing magic,
you're sticking it
out with me! Got it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, familiar! I know you heard me,
so give
me an answer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: How did things end up like this?!
